Title: Effect of PT-Symmetric Operator on Coherence Under the Non-Markovian Environments

In this work, we mainly investigate the effect of PT-symmetric operation on the dynamic behavior of the relative entropy of coherence for a two-level system within non-Markovian environments and put forward a feasible physical scheme to recover coherence by using an optimal PT-symmetric operator. The non-Markovian environment is modeled by an Lindblad superoperator that includes a correlation memory, which is dependent on both the time and the memory parameter. In order to study the effect of PT-symmetric operation, we introduce PT-symmetry in the Lindblad superoperator, in which the coefficients of the first term are changed into the coefficients of the second term. The dynamic of the relative entropy of coherence under the PT-symmetric operation is solved by solving the master equation with PT-symmetry. We analyze the relation between the PT-symmetry and the time, the memory parameter, and the initial state of system. Furthermore, we give a feasible physical method to recover the coherence by using the PT-symmetry, i.e., choosing a optimal time and memory parameter, we can get the maximal value of the relative entropy of coherence. This will provide a new method to protect the coherence, or recover the coherence in a non-Markovian environment by using PT-symmetric operation.
